description: Render the project to an MP4 on Morpha's servers, for an agent that has no browser to drive (a chat app, a Linux box). Returns { renderId, status: 'rendering', next } — call render_status with that renderId after about 30 seconds. It needs a subscription and draws on the account's render allowance, so a longer composition and a larger scale each use more of it. Two other routes need no allowance and are usually better — give the person the editorUrl every project result carries and they choose Share, then Download (Render MP4 on a phone) in the editor, free and with no watermark; or a script runs the morphareels-sdk npm client's client.renderVideo(projectId) on macOS or Windows. Renders at 2x the canvas by default, the same as the editor and the npm client; pass scale: 1 for the canvas's own size, which is faster and uses less allowance. The allowance is checked before the render starts, so a render that would exceed it is refused up front rather than failing partway. Refused for a composition longer than 30 minutes, when the remaining allowance will not cover it, or while 3 renders are already running for this account. The finished file stays downloadable for 7 days, then it is deleted; the project stays and can be rendered again. The render downloads the project's fonts from their hosts, including a custom font's own URL (set_custom_font). Reference: https://morphareels.ai/docs/tools#rendervideopage-scale

page.description: Optional 0-based page index for a multi-page project. Omit for the project's active page; render one page per call.

scale.description: Optional output scale: 2 (the default) renders at twice the canvas, roughly 4K for a portrait project; 1 renders at the canvas's own size for a faster file that uses less allowance. Nothing else is accepted.
